estatePlan.concept: The Canopy Meridian Estate is a flat-land Saint Lucia sanctuary composed as a long, shaded tropical-modern residence between a formal arrival court and a south-facing water garden. Deep stone planes, floating copper-toned roofs, bronze glazing, and planted courts create a resort-scale estate without relying on landform.
estatePlan.character: A monumental yet calm Caribbean contemporary composition: a two-storey main residence anchors entertaining and family life, while low guest and wellness pavilions sit apart in dense garden rooms. The principal south facade opens broadly to an axial infinity-style pool, sunset lawn, and outdoor salon.

requirements.statement: Design an extraordinary $15 million luxury estate in Saint Lucia.
Create a spectacular, original architectural masterpiece with complete creative freedom for buildings, amenities, gardens, and outdoor entertainment spaces.

program.role: swimming, outdoor dining, and sunset recreation
rain-garden perimeter and tropical specimen planting

zones.purpose: formal vehicular approach and shaded pedestrian arrival
primary house with broad south-facing outdoor living
pool axis, outdoor entertaining, and open lawn
secluded guest pavilion in west planting
quiet eastern wellness court and spa pavilion

circulation.purpose: vehicle arrival from estate gate to forecourt
pedestrian sequence from forecourt to principal entry
private pedestrian route to guest pavilion
garden route to wellness pavilion
direct indoor-outdoor entertaining sequence

relationships.intent: driveway meets formal arrival court
forecourt leads to shaded entry walk
entry walk reaches principal door
west door connects residence to guest walk
guest walk reaches guest pavilion
east door connects residence to wellness walk
wellness walk reaches spa pavilion
south glazed walls open directly onto pool terrace
pool terrace contains the water feature
floating roof shelters the primary residence
floating roof shelters guest pavilion
floating roof shelters wellness pavilion

considerations.intent: The long south water axis preserves an open sunset entertaining prospect from the residence.
Guest and wellness pavilions are separated by planted side gardens while retaining short covered-free walks to the main house.
A broad open lawn beyond the pool remains intentionally unbuilt for events and outdoor recreation.
Rain-garden planting frames arrival, cools the pool court, and creates a lush Caribbean estate character on flat ground.

architecture.intent: A long two-storey stone-and-glass residence with a recessed arrival face and a deeply shaded water-garden facade.
A generous formal arrival court and straight motor approach establish a ceremonial threshold.
A linear outdoor salon, pool, and lawn form the estate's primary entertainment landscape.
